candidates.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: standalone square Windows desktop app icon concept for Dockyard, a utility that groups external app windows into one frame with tabs and split panes. Create one polished app icon only, front-facing and centered, large bold simple geometry readable at 16 and 32 pixels. A rounded-square dark charcoal tile with a generous inset and crisp light and blue forms, actual transparent background outside the tile. Flat graphic design with subtly refined depth, clean silhouette, no thin strokes, no fine UI details, no words, letters, numbers, watermark, presentation board, mockup, or multiple icons. Square composition. Concept A: a single solid light window frame containing two blue rectangular panes snapped together, one larger pane and one narrow pane; a short thick blue tab along the upper edge visually explains docking. Very minimal, professional, balanced. Use the existing app's blue #3B82F6 as the accent.
